name: security-scanner
description: Security scanning with an explicit status per scan: SCA across ecosystems and monorepos (trivy/osv-scanner, npm/pnpm/yarn/pip-audit/cargo-audit/govulncheck fallback), secrets in the working tree and history (gitleaks/trufflehog), SAST (semgrep), IaC and container scanning (trivy), license policy, SBOM (CycloneDX/SPDX), SARIF output and diff-only mode
shortDescription: Security scanning (SCA, secrets, SAST, IaC, licenses, SBOM)
